posts.name: Kento
posts.cooked:
For what it’s worth, I’ve been playing for years, I’m still happy to play Ra anytime.

I don’t find that complexity necessarily means more fun, and Ra has interesting interactions in his deck. The reason he’s less complex is that his interactions can mostly be ignored in favorite of just burning everything that moves.

Again, your mileage may vary.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: I don’t think Unity or CC are great, since you have to introduce the idea of non-Character hero targets. Not AA or AZ for obvious reasons, and probably not Bunker either because of his weird tempo. Not Fanatic, because she’s unlikely to pop off. Legacy is a good choice for you to play yourself, since he’s boring and you can turn your brain off. (Christopher does this when he demos.) I think the rest are all fine.
